value.signature: fn fmt (& self , f : & mut std :: fmt :: Formatter < '_ >) -> std :: fmt :: Result

exception.justification: Justified: Formatting supplies the public representation to the enclosing observation boundary and must not recursively create another observation.

review.body: { enum Part < 'a > { Value (& 'a Value) , Text (& 'static str) , Array (& 'a [Value] , bool) , Map (& 'a [(Value , Value)] , bool) , } let mut work = vec ! [Part :: Value (self)] ; while let Some (part) = work . pop () { let value = match part { Part :: Value (value) => value , Part :: Text (text) => { f . write_str (text) ? ; continue ; } Part :: Array (items , first) => { if let Some ((item , rest)) = items . split_first () { if ! first { f . write_str (", ") ? ; } work . push (Part :: Array (rest , false)) ; work . push (Part :: Value (item)) ; } continue ; } Part :: Map (items , first) => { if let Some (((key , item) , rest)) = items . split_first () { if ! first { f . write_str (", ") ? ; } f . write_str ("(") ? ; work . push (Part :: Map (rest , false)) ; work . push (Part :: Text (")")) ; work . push (Part :: Value (item)) ; work . push (Part :: Text (", ")) ; work . push (Part :: Value (key)) ; } continue ; } } ; match value { Self :: Array (array) => { f . write_str ("Array(Array([") ? ; work . push (Part :: Text ("]))")) ; work . push (Part :: Array (& array . 0 , true)) ; } Self :: Map (map) => { f . write_str ("Map(Map([") ? ; work . push (Part :: Text ("]))")) ; work . push (Part :: Map (& map . 0 , true)) ; } Self :: Tag (tag) => { write ! (f , "Tag(Tag {{ number: {}, item: " , tag . number) ? ; work . push (Part :: Text (" })")) ; work . push (Part :: Value (& tag . item)) ; } Self :: Unsigned (value) => write ! (f , "Unsigned({value:?})") ? , Self :: Negative (value) => write ! (f , "Negative({value:?})") ? , Self :: Bytes (value) => write ! (f , "Bytes({value:?})") ? , Self :: Text (value) => write ! (f , "Text({value:?})") ? , Self :: Bool (value) => write ! (f , "Bool({value:?})") ? , Self :: Null => f . write_str ("Null") ? , Self :: Simple (value) => write ! (f , "Simple({value:?})") ? , Self :: Float (value) => write ! (f , "Float({value:?})") ? , } } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-interchange decision for value::<Value as std :: fmt :: Debug>::fmt.
